description: Suggest a Lentra hub configuration for a building, with the reasons, a rent indication (if the country is given) and a configurator link the person can open. Nothing is saved or sent. Use configure_hub to save a configuration for the Lentra team.

can_build_into_wall.description: true if the lobby wall can take a recess and glazing (new build or fit-out stage); false if not (finished lobby, listed or leased space).

country.description: Country of the building (ISO code). Needed for the rent indication.

language.description: Language for the configurator link. Default en.

priority.description: income favours the two-year term (+20% rent); flexibility the one-year term.

units.description: Homes, rooms, beds or desks in the building.

name: suggest_hub_configuration
title: Suggest a hub for a building
